daily_plan_req: Sam Moore likes to talk a walk around Johnson Park, and sit at Hobbs cafe reading.
name: Sam Moore
learned: Sam Moore is a retired navy officer who loves to share stories from his time in the military. He is always full of interesting stories and advice.
currently: Sam Moore lives with his wife of 40 years, Jennifer Moore, and spends his free time tending the park and is an avid reader. Sam is planning on running for local mayor in the upcoming election and he is telling is neighbors about it
lifestyle: Sam Moore goes to bed around 9pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 5pm.
daily_req: wake up and complete the morning routine at 5:00 am
f_daily_schedule: sleeping
Sam is waking up and starting his morning routine (asleep)
Sam is finishing his morning routine and heading out to Johnson Park for his morning walk
Sam is finishing his walk around Johnson Park and heading to Hobbs Cafe for his morning coffee and reading
Sam is sitting at Hobbs Cafe, sipping his second cup of coffee, deeply engrossed in a biography about naval history, occasionally jotting notes for his mayoral campaign speech

Sam is finishing his second cup of coffee at Hobbs Cafe, closing his book, and beginning his walk back home to help Jennifer with the morning chores before he starts talking to his neighbors about his mayoral campaign

Sam is back home, helping Jennifer tidy up the kitchen, then stepping out onto the front porch to greet his neighbor, Bill, and enthusiastically share his plans for running for mayor, inviting Bill to hear more over a cup of coffee later

Sam is still on the front porch with Bill, animatedly discussing his vision for the town's parks and local infrastructure, and he suggests they walk over to Hobbs Cafe together so he can share more details over a cup of coffee

Sam is wrapping up his conversation with Bill at Hobbs Cafe, paying for both their coffees, and heading back home to have a light lunch with Jennifer before he plans to visit a few more neighbors this afternoon to discuss his mayoral campaign
Sam is having a light lunch with Jennifer at home, then reviewing his campaign notes before heading out to visit a few more neighbors this afternoon
Sam is visiting his neighbor, Carol, on Maple Street, sharing his mayoral campaign flyers and listening to her concerns about local road maintenance, while making notes in his small pocket notebook

Sam is finishing his visit with Carol on Maple Street, thanking her for her input, and walking over to the Jenkins' house two doors down to continue sharing his campaign ideas and listening to their thoughts on community events
Sam is finishing his conversation with the Jenkins family, thanking them for their time, and heading back home to review his campaign notes and prepare for dinner with Jennifer
Sam is having dinner with Jennifer at home, discussing his afternoon visits with neighbors and sharing highlights from his campaign notes, before winding down for the evening
Sam is finishing dinner with Jennifer, clearing the table, and then settling into his favorite armchair in the living room to read the evening newspaper and relax before his usual 9pm bedtime
Sam is relaxing in his armchair, putting down the newspaper and turning on the evening news, while making a few mental notes for tomorrow's campaign conversations before he winds down for bed

Sam is turning off the evening news, setting aside his notepad, and heading to the bathroom to brush his teeth and wash up, preparing to turn in for the night a bit earlier than his usual 9pm bedtime so he can be well-rested for another day of campaigning tomorrow
Sam is asleep in bed, having turned in a bit early, resting up for another day of campaigning and community walks tomorrow
Sam is asleep in bed, having turned in early, resting peacefully for another day of campaigning and community walks tomorrow
